rubric.role_summary: Field-based sales and marketing role promoting electric motorbikes in Kenya through lead generation, product demonstrations, customer relationships, and local market outreach.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Field-based sales and marketing role promoting electric motorbikes in Kenya through lead generation, product demonstrations, customer relationships, and local market outreach.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Diploma or degree in Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
- 2+ years of experience in sales, marketing, or a related field.
- Experience in direct-to-consumer sales.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Direct-to-consumer sales experience in the automotive industry.
- Proficiency with Excel and mobile sales tools.
- Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Nairobi, Kenya area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.

interpretation.user_instruction: for multiple locations, accept either one, broaden the area to the general area if it's a specific city, if remote + a location, please force them into the location, follow the text rather than the metadata, for x-y years exp, unbound the top but evaluate obviously overqualified candidates as failures in the final fit eval, other than that, assume the less strict of interpretations (eg masters required versus masters or phd, eval as if masters or phd)
resolved_ambiguities: The description specifies working from Nairobi offices, while the location metadata also lists Kitengela and Thika. Confirm whether those secondary locations are available on-site work bases.
interpretation.resolution: Text wins: Nairobi general-area worksite; Kitengela/Thika are not separate office alternatives.
